one_liner_zh: 威瑞森EPS超預期、營收年增2.85%，高股息電信營運穩中向好。
one_liner_en: Verizon beat EPS with 2.85% revenue growth, as the high-dividend telecom operated steadily upward.
ai_view_zh: 訊號偏正向：EPS超標與溫和營收年增顯示營運穩定、定價與成本控制改善，契合低估值高股息防禦標的。短中期股價以11.57倍低本益比與股息殖利率為支撐，下檔有限但成長題材有限。中期關鍵在去槓桿進度與用戶留存。追蹤指標：後付手機淨增與流失率、無線服務營收與ARPU、寬頻用戶成長、自由現金流與淨負債／EBITDA，以及股息覆蓋率。
ai_view_en: Signal is mildly positive: an EPS beat and modest revenue growth show stable operations with improving pricing and cost control, fitting a low-valuation, high-dividend defensive name. Near to mid-term, the stock is anchored by an 11.57x P/E and dividend yield, limiting downside but also upside. Mid-term, deleveraging progress and subscriber retention are key. Track: postpaid phone net adds and churn, wireless service revenue and ARPU, broadband subscriber growth, free cash flow and net debt/EBITDA, and dividend coverage.
highlights_zh: EPS 1.28美元，超越預期1.21美元，正向驚喜5.81%
營收344.4億美元，年增2.85%溫和成長
無線服務與寬頻用戶穩定貢獻經常性現金流
本益比11.57偏低且股息殖利率具吸引力
highlights_en: EPS of $1.28 beat the $1.21 estimate, a 5.81% positive surprise
Wireless service and broadband subscribers provide steady recurring cash flow
A low 11.57x P/E and attractive dividend yield
risks_zh: 高負債在利率環境下增加利息支出壓力
電信市場競爭激烈，後付用戶淨增與ARPU承壓
資本支出與5G／光纖投資持續消耗自由現金流
risks_en: High debt adds interest-expense pressure in the rate environment
Intense telecom competition pressures postpaid net adds and ARPU
Capex and 5G/fiber investment continue to consume free cash flow
